description: The Energy Data eXchange (EDX) is the data repository and collaboration platform of the US Department of Energy's National Energy Technology Laboratory (NETL). The home page read on 2026-09-26 offers search, contribution of resources, groups, portfolios, private workspaces, tools, the EDX Spatial map environment and an EDX Assistant, and states that users sign up or log in to gain access; its counters of registered users, resources and downloads are filled by script and were not read. The footer links the DOE Hydrocarbons and Geothermal Energy Office, the Office of Critical Minerals and Energy Innovation and the Office of Electricity. Several NETL datasets already in this catalogue, such as the coal power plant reinvestment visualisation and the NEWTS energy-wastewater dataset, are hosted on EDX. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): mostly public domain (NETL copyright status notice); datasets on EDX carry their own licences. Caveats: much of the site needs a modern browser and an account, and public and restricted resources are mixed. Simulation uses are locating subsurface, pipeline, carbon storage and grid datasets for energy infrastructure models. Related records: data-netl-newts-integrated-energy-wastewater-dataset and data-coal-power-plant-reinvestment-visualization-tool are hosted here.
